##### Project general facts

The Highbury introduces a new standard of contemporary living in Mohammed Bin Rashid City, an emerging extension of Downtown Dubai. The development features a striking architectural concept formed by two interconnected structures, each with its own visual identity, seamlessly combined into one cohesive design. The stepped façade creates a smooth transition from landscaped ground-level gardens to upper-level residences, including elegant duplex apartments and a rooftop terrace, offering a dynamic and visually engaging living environment.

Residents benefit from a selection of thoughtfully designed amenities that promote a balanced and modern lifestyle. The project offers inviting communal spaces for relaxation and social interaction, along with beautifully integrated outdoor areas that enhance everyday living. The combination of greenery, leisure facilities, and well-planned shared spaces creates a vibrant yet tranquil atmosphere within the development.

The interiors feature modern finishing with high-quality materials, including wood-look flooring, refined textures, and a soft neutral palette. Living areas are designed with open-plan layouts and sleek detailing, while bedrooms offer built-in wardrobes and a calm, comfortable ambiance. Bathrooms are finished with porcelain surfaces, marble accents, and walk-in showers for a spa-like feel. The kitchens are designed with an open layout, light wood cabinetry, and are equipped with appliances. The apartments are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Mohammed Bin Rashid City brings to you the best of fashion, luxury, dining, and entertainment offerings, designed to complement your distinguished lifestyle. Hartland Square and Hartland Boulevard are the places to be for the most coveted fashion, luxury and retail brands. The Walk is where you will find trendy cafes and ultra-sophisticated restaurants, serving the finest cuisines, and overlooking the well-designed water features that line the community.

The community of MBR City goes beyond residential offerings. It boasts world-class amenities and attractions that enrich the lives of residents and visitors alike. From state-of-the-art educational institutions and healthcare facilities to luxury hotels, shopping malls, and entertainment venues, MBR City provides a comprehensive range of services and experiences that cater to every need and desire.

MBR City is designed to foster a sense of community and engagement among its residents. The community hosts various cultural events, sports competitions, and recreational activities that bring people together, encouraging social interactions and creating a vibrant atmosphere. Additionally, the community features cycling tracks, jogging trails, and equestrian facilities, catering to individuals who appreciate an active and outdoor lifestyle. Strategically located, MBR City offers convenient connectivity to other key areas of Dubai. It has excellent transportation links, including major highways and public transportation networks, ensuring that residents have easy access to the city's business districts, leisure destinations, and cultural landmarks.
